name: San Juan Channel
where: Off Friday Harbor, in the middle of the islands
teaches: Room to learn in, with a tide that matters. A beat down to Griffin Bay and a run home on the flood.

name: Cattle Pass
where: Inside the south entrance, off Griffin Bay
teaches: The strongest tide in the islands. Go out through the pass and come back with the stream, or against it.

name: Spieden Channel
where: Off Roche Harbor, bound round Spieden Island
teaches: Pilotage. A channel that runs hard east or west, then round the island by New Channel and home.

name: Harney Channel
where: Off the Orcas landing, on the ferry lane
teaches: Narrow water between Orcas and Shaw with ferries about, then out by Thatcher Pass to Rosario Strait.
